image_description: A close-up view of a large marine mammal, identified as a grey whale, surfacing in blue water. The image captures the dorsal side of the whale's back and head area, showing dark grey skin with lighter mottling and white patches (barnacles). Water is splashing around the body, indicating movement. No flippers or tail flukes are clearly visible due to the framing and water obstruction.

The background water has a uniform, painterly blur that lacks the natural variance of real ocean surfaces, though this could also be attributed to depth-of-field effects in photography.
